query:
SELECT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM items i
            WHERE i.barcode = $1
              AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR i.id <> $4)
              AND ((i.owner_id IS NULL AND i.family_id IS NULL)
                   OR i.owner_id = $2
                   OR i.family_id = $3
                   OR i.family_id IN (SELECT family_id FROM family_mems WHERE user_id = $2))
        ) AS "is_taken!"
